poses.caption: Lie on your side with straight legs stacked and your head supported by the lower arm. Keep your hips stacked.
Lift the top leg without rolling your pelvis back, pause, then lower slowly. Repeat on both sides.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical illustration canonical1427 STRAIGHT LEG OUTER HIP ABDUCTOR. TWO equal square cells side by side wide2:1 landscape, same full body person camera scale. Lie on LEFT SIDE on thin gray mat, head LEFT feet RIGHT. Bottom LEFT arm bent supporting head comfortably with left palm under temple, left elbow rests mat; top RIGHT hand rests on mat in FRONT of waist for balance. Shoulders and hips stacked vertically NO rolling backward. LEFT START BOTH legs STRAIGHT stacked aligned torso, bottom leg rests mat and top right leg rests over left. RIGHT FINISH raise TOP RIGHT STRAIGHT leg laterally up about35degrees, pelvis stacked and still, knee points forward same direction as torso, foot neutral toes forward not rotated upward. Bottom leg remains straight grounded, torso/head/support arms unchanged. Primary top RIGHT OUTER HIP ABDUCTORS only diffuse RED teaching tint over intact black shorts lateral upper hip gluteus medius area, NOT thigh/calf or lower buttocks. Smooth opaque fabric broad real folds NO anatomy fibers visible through cloth. Exposed limbs fine detailed grayscale anatomy realistic hands proportions. Full opaque BLACK tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK and BLACK MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH with continuous hems and seams. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins head supporting elbow both feet raised leg hand mat all within EACH square no crop. Equal male/female quality. Original project reference rendering STYLE ONLY ignore pushup/chest red. No text captions arrows extra figures.
jobs.inspectionNote: Two side-lying straight leg hip abduction candidates, four poses, two built-in calls. Legs stacked to top leg lifted, head supported by lower hand and upper hand on mat, outer upper hip red tint on intact shorts. Full opaque clothes and grayscale exposed anatomy retained. Qualified pelvis stacking versus backward roll, femoral rotation/toe direction, neck support, hip range and male/female fine-detail consistency require human review. Original project artwork style only, no upstream licensed input. Exact prompts/originals saved. No anatomy or clothing approval or publication. Seven pipeline checks do not establish anatomical accuracy.
